title: Writing: My Dream Job
writingModel: My dream job is to work as an international education consultant. I want to help students around the world access quality education.
I would work for an international organisation — perhaps UNESCO or a large NGO. I would travel to different countries, meet teachers and students, and help create better learning programmes.

To achieve this dream, I need to develop several skills. First, I need to improve my English to a very high level. Second, I plan to do a master's degree in international education after my bachelor's. Third, I hope to do an internship with an NGO in my third year.

I also need to develop soft skills: communication, empathy, and the ability to work in multicultural teams. I have already made progress — my English has improved greatly this year, and I have attended three WKU career workshops.
I believe that the future belongs to those who prepare for it. My dream job is possible — if I work hard and stay focused.
